registered_condition: ÖFI Austria grants and Eurimages operate on independent tracks.
AU Location Offset and Screen NSW can be combined for foreign productions with significant NSW spend; Screen NSW support reduces Location Offset QAPE basis.
AU Location Offset and Screen Queensland can be combined for foreign productions with significant Queensland spend; Screen QLD support reduces Location Offset QAPE basis.
SAFC financial assistance reduces qualifying QAPE for Location Offset.
Screen Australia equity is government financial assistance; reduces qualifying Australian production expenditure (QAPE) for Location Offset (ITAA97 §376-170).
Screenwest WA financial assistance is government financial assistance; reduces qualifying Australian production expenditure (QAPE) for the Location Offset.
AU Location Offset and VicScreen can be combined for foreign productions with significant Victorian spend; VicScreen support is government assistance reducing Location Offset QAPE basis.
MIFF Premiere Fund grant is not government financial assistance; does not reduce QAPE for Producer Offset.
Screen Australia equity investment is government assistance — reduces qualifying spend basis for Screen NSW incentive.
SAFC (South Australian Film Corporation) financial assistance is government financial assistance reducing qualifying Australian production expenditure (QAPE) for Producer Offset (ITAA97 §376-170).
Screen Australia equity is government financial assistance; reduces QAPE for Producer Offset.
Screen Australia equity investment is government assistance — reduces qualifying spend basis for Screen Queensland incentive.
SAFC financial assistance reduces qualifying QAPE for Screen Australia matching calculations.

Australian state film funds (Screenwest WA and SAFC SA) are generally mutually exclusive as they require territorial spend in competing states. A production qualifying primarily in WA would not typically also qualify in SA.
Screen Australia equity investment is government assistance — reduces qualifying spend basis for ScreenWest WA incentive.
Screen Australia equity investment is government assistance — reduces qualifying spend basis for VicScreen incentive.
Belgian tax shelter and Screen.Brussels operate on independent tracks. Both may be used on the same production with Brussels qualifying spend.

Belgian tax shelter and VAF Flanders operate on independent tracks. Tax shelter is a financing instrument; VAF is a regional production fund. Both may be used on the same production with Flanders qualifying spend.

Belgian tax shelter and Wallimage operate on independent tracks. Tax shelter is a financing instrument; Wallimage is a regional production fund. Both may be used on the same production with Wallonia qualifying spend.
Eurimages support allocated to Belgian co-producers does not reduce Belgian tax shelter qualifying eligible expenditure. Both are available for the same official European co-production.
Eurimages support does not reduce VAF Flanders qualifying spend.
Eurimages support does not reduce Wallimage qualifying spend.
Bulgarian cash rebate and Eurimages operate on independent tracks; Eurimages does not reduce Bulgarian qualifying spend basis.
CMF contributions are government assistance under provincial income tax acts; reduce qualifying BC labour expenditure for PSTC computation.
CMPA Foreign certificate (service production) and BC PSTC can be combined: PSTC does not require Canadian content certification for foreign shoots.

CPTC applies only to Canadian domestic content productions (ITA §125.4). BC PSTC applies only to accredited foreign service productions (ITA §125.5). A production cannot simultaneously qualify for both — production type is mutually exclusive.
Telefilm equity constitutes government assistance; reduces qualifying BC labour expenditure for PSTC.
Bell Fund grants are government assistance under ITA §125.4; reduces CPTC qualified labour expenditure (T4283).
Bell Fund grants are government assistance under Ontario CTA; reduce qualifying Ontario labour expenditure for OFTTC.
CMF contributions are government assistance under ITA §125.4; reduce qualified labour expenditure before computing CPTC (T4283).
CMF contributions are government assistance under Ontario CTA; reduce qualifying Ontario labour expenditure for OFTTC computation.
CMF contributions are government assistance under Ontario CTA; reduce qualifying Ontario labour expenditure for OPSTC computation.
CMF contributions are government assistance under Quebec CTA; reduce qualifying Quebec labour expenditure for SODEC credit computation.
CMPA Foreign certificate (service production) and Ontario OFTTC can be combined: OFTTC does not require Canadian content certification.
NSI fund grants are government assistance under ITA §125.4; reduces CPTC qualified labour expenditure (T4283).

Quebec QPRDP (foreign service) and CPTC (domestic content) are typically different production tracks. Stacking may be possible for official treaty co-productions where both domestic and foreign elements qualify. Legal review required before claiming both.
Telefilm equity constitutes government assistance under ITA §125.4; reduces CPTC qualified labour expenditure (T4283).
NOHFC grant is government assistance under ITA §125.4; reduces CPTC qualified labour expenditure (T4283).

OFTTC tax credit is government assistance under ITA §125.4(1)(b) and must be deducted from Qualified Canadian Labour Expenditure (QCLE) before computing CPTC. Net QCLE = gross QCLE minus OFTTC amount received or receivable.

CPTC applies only to Canadian domestic content productions (ITA §125.4). Ontario OPSTC applies only to accredited foreign service productions (ITA §125.5). A production cannot simultaneously qualify for both — production type is mutually exclusive.
Quebec SODEC film production credit is government assistance under ITA §125.4(1)(b). QC credit amount must be deducted from QCLE before computing CPTC.
Telefilm equity constitutes government assistance; reduces qualifying Quebec labour expenditure for QPRDP.
Telefilm equity constitutes government assistance; reduces qualifying Ontario labour expenditure for OFTTC.
Telefilm equity constitutes government assistance; reduces qualifying Quebec labour expenditure for SODEC credit.

DFI Denmark grants and Eurimages operate on independent tracks.
Fyn Film and DR can co-finance on independent tracks.
DR and Eurimages both operate on independent financing tracks.

Valencia IVC support and ICAA operate on independent tracks.
Ibermedia grant and Spanish ICAA national deduction operate on independent tracks.
RTVE and Eurimages both operate on independent financing tracks.
RTVE and Ibermedia both operate on independent financing tracks.

SES Finland grants and Eurimages operate on independent tracks.

Eurimages support does not reduce ICA Portugal qualifying spend.

Screen Yorkshire equity is co-financing, not government assistance. Does not reduce AVEC qualifying UK expenditure.
Croatian cash rebate and HAVC fund operate on independent tracks; HAVC grant does not reduce rebate qualifying basis for foreign spend.
Ibermedia grants do not reduce Irish qualifying expenditure for Section 481. Portugal and Spain are Ibermedia members; Ireland is not, but applicable for IE minority service arrangements.
Ibermedia and Nordic Film & TV Fund operate on independent tracks; Spain-Portugal combinations with Nordic partners can access both.
Ibermedia grant and ICA Portugal grant operate on independent tracks.

UK AVEC and IE Section 481 can both be claimed for the same production when qualifying expenditure is incurred in both the UK and Ireland. Each credit applies only to its own territory's qualifying spend — no double-counting.
Israeli rebate and Israeli Film Fund operate on independent tracks; Film Fund grant does not reduce rebate qualifying basis.

Iceland Film Rebate and Iceland Post-Production Rebate can be combined if expenditure categories are distinct; post-production rebate is government assistance reducing Film Rebate qualifying basis for overlapping costs.
Lazio and Apulia regional funds may be stackable with qualifying regional spend in each.

Sicilia and Campania regional funds may be stackable with qualifying regional spend in each.
Campania Film Commission and MiC national credit operate on independent tracks.
Lazio and Piemonte regional funds may be stackable if qualifying spend is incurred in both regions.

Multiple Italian regional film commissions may be stackable if the production incurs qualifying spend in both regions. Requires separate applications to each regional commission and regional spend documentation.
Lazio Cinema International regional fund and Italian MiC tax credit operate on independent tracks. Both claimable on qualifying Italian spend.
Lazio and Tuscany regional funds may be stackable with qualifying regional spend in each.
Piemonte Film Commission and MiC national credit operate on independent tracks.
RAI Cinema broadcaster obligation does not reduce qualifying Italian expenditure for the MiC tax credit. Both available for same Italian production.
Sicilia Film Commission and MiC national credit operate on independent tracks.
Tuscany Film Commission and MiC national credit operate on independent tracks.

Viken Filmsenter and NRK operate on independent co-financing tracks.
NOHFC grant reduces OFTTC qualifying labour expenditure basis (OMDC guidelines).

New York's principal film production credit (ny_state_film) and the Empire State Post-Production Credit (us_ny_post_production_credit) are mutually exclusive for the same qualified costs (tax.ny.gov: 'no other income tax credit may be claimed for those costs'). A production may claim the principal credit for its production spend and the post credit for a genuinely separate post-only routing, but never both against the same cost base within one structure.
NZ SPGR rebate and Air NZ production support operate on independent tracks.
NZ SPGR rebate and Tourism NZ film support operate on independent tracks.

OFTTC applies to Ontario domestic Canadian content productions. OPSTC applies to foreign service productions using Ontario. A production cannot be both a domestic content production (OFTTC) and a foreign service production (OPSTC) simultaneously.
Film Stockholm and SVT operate on independent co-financing tracks.
Film i Skåne and SVT operate on independent co-financing tracks.
Thailand film rebate and Thailand Creative Economy fund operate on independent tracks.
UK HVC and AVEC are mutually exclusive: HVC is the service-production route, AVEC requires BFI cultural test or co-production treaty.
